text:
maya: Heads up — our sampleapp rerank flow is returning embeddings with inconsistent vector dims. Sent a batch of 4, got 3 vectors of 768 and 1 of 1024.

devon: Oof. Are you using the SDK or curl? Can you paste the request/response (trim secrets) so we can repro?

maya: Node SDK 0.8.2, using embeddings.batch([...]) from the sample app. Minimal repro: 
```js
const inputs = ['q1','q2','q3','q4'];
const r = await client.embeddings.create({model: 'open-embed-1', input: inputs});
// r.data is an array of embeddings, lengths vary 
console.log(r.data.map(e => e.embedding.length)); // -> [768,768,768,1024]
```

carlos: that pattern rings a bell — batching helper concatenates requests and then slices responses assuming stable order. If a retry drops one item and then succeeds later, indices can shift.

anna: yup, we've hit this before when the SDK retry does a partial retry on HTTP 502s. The retry path replays only the failed chunk but doesn't re-align original indices in the helper.

maya: interesting — I did see some 502s in the logs before the mismatched vector showed up.

devon: can you try turning off client-side automatic retries and see if shape stabilizes? e.g. `client.config({retry: 0})` or send single-item requests. That will tell us if it's a retry reorder bug.

maya: tried `retry: 0` — now all 4 vects are 768. So looks like a retry-induced misalignment.

carlos: workaround for now: either disable retries for batched embed requests or use the new `batchingHelpers.splitPreserveOrder()` helper (we should document that better).

anna: filing an SDK bug today. We need: (1) detect partial success+retry and preserve original index mapping, (2) add an integration test that simulates partial 5xxs across a batch.

sdk-bot: FYI docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/batching — added note about retry hazards and recommended patterns (:book:).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out a runtime guard on the hosted side that returns 503 instead of partial 200s for incr uploads at 10:32 UTC (helps detect server-side partial-accept).

devon: long term we should prefer an idempotent per-item ack protocol or include per-item sequence ids in responses so SDK can re-order safely. I'll add a design ticket.

maya: thanks y'all — with retry off for now the sampleapp is stable. Please ping when the SDK patch lands so we can re-enable retries. :thumbsup:

carlos: noted — PR coming to fix index preservation. Will add a small migration note for anyone using `embeddings.batch`.
